description: The chart represents the distribution of topics in a dataset, comparing the proportions of different categories. The pie chart is divided into five slices, representing the categories "Topics", "Common", "Person", "Book", and "Sport". The "Topics" slice is colored light blue and accounts for approximately 41.2% of the chart, while "Common" is green and makes up around 14.9%. The "Person" category is pink and constitutes about 30.5%, "Book" is yellow and represents 9.1%, and "Sport" is purple, making up 4.3%. The chart includes a legend that maps the colors to their corresponding categories, and percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice ("Topics") at the top, followed by "Person", "Common", "Book", and "Sport".
